messages:
kevin: FYI PR #4892 updates the migration guide and adds new SDK examples. I pushed and the Netlify preview shows CSS and image 404s for hashed assets. Can someone triage?

tara: I looked at the Netlify deploy logs: build step succeeded but the published folder contains `assets` at `site/assets` while the html references `/static/assets/...` — looks like a prefix change from a prior config.

build-bot: CI: docs-preview build finished for branch feature/migration-sdks. Linkcheck: 2 missing assets (/static/assets/logo-9f2e.png, /static/assets/main-9f2e.css). Full log: https://ci.redwood/internal/1937001234/logs

kevin: Huh, earlier we had `/assets/...` but this `/static/assets` is new. Did anyone update mkdocs or the theme?

tara: We bumped mkdocs-material in a different PR; its output path changed when combined with our custom `extra_javascript` handling. Quick fix for this PR: change references in the migration guide and includes from `/static/assets/` -> `assets/` (relative) and add a one-line note in the PR about the temporary fix.

doc-reviewer: Also note for SDK snippets: node install name changed recently. Current npm package is `@redwood-inference/sdk`. Our docs still show `@redwood/sdk` so tests might confuse users. Add both variants in the snippet and mark preferred.

kevin: I'll make the asset path tweak and update the node/python examples to show both package names and env-var keys. Will also add local preview instructions for reviewers.

ops: Small operational note: Netlify staging queue is slow right now; if preview fails to update after a push, try clearing the deploy cache or trigger a manual redeploy in the Netlify UI. If you need a fast check, run `mkdocs build -d site` locally and serve with `python -m http.server --directory site 8000`.

kevin: Patch pushed: replaced `/static/assets/` -> `assets/`, added Local preview blurb to PR description, and updated SDK snippets to include both package names and use env vars for keys.

build-bot: CI: docs-preview re-run started. Netlify deploy triggered: https://app.netlify.com/sites/docs-redwood/deploys/2999

doc-reviewer: Quick review: snippets look good. Tiny nit: prefer `client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))` in python and `const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` in node. Also add a one-line note about mkdocs-material==9.1.7 to avoid confusion.

kevin: Updated those nits and pinned mkdocs-material in docs/requirements.txt. Re-pushed.

build-bot: Netlify deploy finished: success. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4892--docs.redwood.ai

doc-reviewer: Linkcheck pass, no 404s. LGTM from me.

kevin: Thanks everyone. Planning to merge at 16:10 PT after the staging window clears. Filing DOCS-241 to track a global template cleanup so we don't keep patching individual PRs.

ops: Noted on DOCS-241. If you decide to change site_dir or base_url globally, coordinate with infra to avoid preview flakiness.

kevin: Will do. Merge incoming. :shipit:
